name: Glenrowan West Solar Farm
notable: 110 MW solar farm near Glenrowan, VIC. Part of a cluster of solar farms in Victoria's north-east.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: ESC Generation Authority Application – Glenrowan West Solar Farm (Public submission), Glenrowan Sun Farm Pty Ltd / Wirsol Energy
eis_specs.connection_distance_note: Short 66 kV circuit into AusNet Glenrowan Terminal Station; Connection Services Agreement with AusNet executed July 2019, AEMO 5.3.4A letter Jan 2018
eis_specs.notes: Wirtgen Invest (private German family office) equity owner via Glenrowan Sun Farm Pty Ltd; Wirsol Energy (WEL, now Gentari) construction/asset manager and O&M provider. 149 MWp DC / 110 MW AC (DC:AC ~1.35). 373,248 Jinko 395–400 Wp modules, single-axis NEXTracker horizontal tracker, 48 x SMA SC 2.75 MW central inverters. EPC Signal Energy Australia. 323 ha near Glenrowan, ~250 km NE of Melbourne. Construction commenced Jan 2020; first export Dec 2020; COD Q1 2021.
